notes: Категория обновления: Глобальное. SkyRealm Launcher 1.2.31 + Game 0.20.50.101: verified account session UI; friends, private chat and co-op room invitations; update center with rollback and repair; custom game install folder; FPS cap, separate music and effects volume, remappable keyboard controls and accessibility settings; F12 screenshots with in-launcher gallery; local game calendar and support center with diagnostics report; multi-service status and local performance monitor; cloud world backups; in-app notifications; 41 built-in mods with gameplay effects; external SkyRealmStudio desktop editor with automatic installed-app detection, one-click official download, SHA-256 verification and launch; in-game script editor removed; direct script-mod publishing from SkyRealm Mod Studio with pre-publication validation and launcher-to-game synchronization; public community mod catalog with account-verified ZIP publishing, archive validation, search, categories, downloads and SHA-256 metadata. World favorites and saved mod profiles; progress statistics for playtime, worlds, level and achievements; VSync low-latency Canvas option; sea expedition with animated ocean waves, detailed ship and sailor, visible sharks and underwater creatures, reefs, islands and shipwrecks; repairs missing marine populations in existing sea saves; robust WASD, arrow keys, physical-key-code navigation across keyboard layouts and on-screen hold-to-sail sea controls; account buttons hidden after server-verified login; friend presence (online, away, do not disturb, in-game); expanded six-stage technology progression with physically placed fuel generators, solar panels, batteries, automated mining drills, ore processors, powered shields, turrets, lamps and settlement walls; scheduled night sieges with real monsters spawned around world rifts, live combat tracking for weapon, magic, pet and turret kills, automatic cleanup and save recovery; ancient guardian awakenings with visible map beacons, directional markers and proximity-based combat; five-room Lost Citadel expedition with persistent room progress and rarity-based relic equipment that boosts player damage and defense; expansion progress is stored in each world save; Boss Realm Awakening adds the Ashen Titan, Ice Empress, Mirror of the Abyss and Worldbreaker Colossus raid, four animated arenas with lava and elemental effects, two repeatable guardian trials, ten passive relics, and new world events; four fixed Boss World arenas route major bosses to their assigned arenas; 12 professions (Lumberjack, Miner, Farmer, Hunter, Fisherman, Builder, Crafter, Blacksmith, Alchemist, Cook, Explorer and Technologist) track real actions automatically, with repeatable contracts, career XP, levels, rewards and resource bonuses; Russian and English in-game language selection; and an expanded ordinary world with a stone quarry, an eight-level underground mine with branching galleries, side passages, support beams, breakable resource barrels and cave creatures, deeper mithril/uranium/diamond deposits, pickaxe upgrades, regrowing veins, compost and fertilizer recipes, stonemason ranks, stone sales and delivery contracts; six new mods add bonuses for forestry, farming, crafting, geology, cooking and power generation; both in-game admin and moderator panels add one-click God armor set, Abyss Blade and maximum gear upgrades, including a persistent leggings slot with real damage mitigation; existing accounts and local worlds remain compatible. Adds a dedicated player voting page with server-backed one-account voting, duplicate idea merging and promotion after three different player submissions; includes the live development roadmap, categorized release history and generated posters for major/global updates; Boss Realm tree chopping can awaken the animated, hostile Awakened Tree with glowing eyes, moving root legs, root-snare attacks and a guaranteed Heartwood Core trophy; ordinary-world forests now contain rare animated fruit-bearing trees that yield forest berries when chopped. Adds the Ancient Forest in Boss Realm with rune-marked ancient trees, mineable crystal and stone deposits, the Forest King raid boss awakened after five chopped ancient trees, multi-phase root-wave combat and summoned forest guardians, a unique Heart of the Ancient Forest relic, the Root Crypt guardian trial, a root trap and a cursed treasure chest. Ordinary worlds now include roaming deer, foxes, boars, owls and hares that can be fed berries for rare gifts; the hidden Whispering Cave guardian encounter and treasure; abandoned settlement ambushes; recurring night bandit raids; seasonal snow, leaves and petals; and persistent tree regrowth after three ordinary-world days or five Boss Realm days.
